Mohit Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 21
November, 2024 
Author: Alok Mathur
Bench: Alok Mathur
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
? Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:77118
Court No. - 6 
Case :- Writ - A No. - 10805 of 2024 
Petitioner :- Mohit Kumar
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of Food And Civil Supply Lko And An
Counsel for Petitioner :- Abhishek Tiwari,Anuj Kudesia,Rishabh Chauhan
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Alok Mathur,J.
1.  Heard Sri Anuj Kudesia along with Sri Abhishek Tiwari for the petitioner and the Standing counsel for the respondents.
2. By means of the present writ petition the petitioner has challenged order dated 19.10.2024 passed by Commissioner, Food and Civil Supply, U.P. thereby placing the petitioner under suspension.s 3. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is working on the post of Marketing Inspector and is posted as Centre In-Charge in Banda Mandi in Powayan Tehsil,
District Shahjahanpur including FCI Roshar Kothi Depot. It seems that there are several allegations Mohit Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 21 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84869127/
1 with regard to sub standard food grains being supplied to fair price shops which is not fit for human consumption since July, 2024 and looking into various complaints even the local MLA has raised the said issue before the competent authority which led the government officials to look into the matter and conduct a preliminary inquiry into the food-grains. The preliminary inquiry was got conducted by a team consisting with Supply Inspector, Marketing Inspector, Food Safety Officials,
who found that between 40 to 60 bags of wheat food-grains which was not fit for human consumption had been dispatched to various fair price shops for distribution. It has also been brought on record that the said food grains was stored in Roshar Kothi ware house maintained by FCI though it is the stand of the FCI that prior to dispatch a technical team conducts inspection of the food-grains but it seems that they had failed to check the quality of food-grains which was sub-standard. In the preliminary inquiry report the role of the petitioner was also highlighted and it is for the said reason that District Magistrate, Shahjahanpur after considering the preliminary inquiry report had issued a direction on 15.10.2024 to take action against all the persons responsible and to suspend them and also to initiate disciplinary proceedings. It is in pursuance of the order of the District Magistrate that the petitioner by means of the impugned order dated 19.10.2024 has been suspended. 
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has vehemently submitted that the petitioner is not involved at any stage and the allegations of the preliminary report does not record any finding involving petitioner and also that the order for holding inquiry in the said matter has been passed without any application of mind. 
5. Learned counsel for the respondents, on the other hand, has opposed the writ petition and informed this Court that charge sheet has already been issued which has been tried to be served upon the petitioner and shall be served shortly. 
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner after arguing the matter at some length submits that the grievance of the petitioner shall be substantially redressed in case the respondents are directed to conclude the inquiry proceedings with expedition considering that the petitioner has been placed under suspension by passing the impugned order dated 19.10.2024. 
7. Learned Standing counsel does not oppose the prayer made by the petitioner. 
8. Accordingly, it is provided that the respondents shall serve a copy of the charge sheet upon the petitioner within next seven days. On receipt of the charge sheet the inquiry proceedings shall be concluded with expedition, say within next three months from the date a certified copy of this order is placed before him. 
9. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner shall cooperate in the proceedings before the inquiry officer. It is further provided that in case the inquiry proceedings are not concluded within the time prescribed by this Court, liberty is given to the petitioner to move appropriate application under Section 4 sub-clause 8 of U.P. Government Servants (Discipline and Appeal) Rules of 1999. In case, such an application is made, the competent authority shall consider and decide the same by passing a reasoned and speaking order within one week from the date of Mohit Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 21 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84869127/
2 date of receipt of the same and communicate the same to the petitioner. 
10. With aforesaid direction the petition stands disposed of.
(Alok Mathur, J.) Order Date :- 21.11.2024 RKM .
